sources.title: PDF Evaluating a Multitask AI Model versus Humans for Portion Size Estimation
sources.snippet: Over the past decade, numerous studies 84 have examined AI in dietary assessment, particularly for portion size estimation. AI-based tools, 85 including image recognition models, augmented reality (AR) interfaces, and immersive digital 86 dietitians, have shown promising results in improving accuracy and reducing respondent burden.
